questions.stem: Which of the following statements about Minimal Alveolar Concentration (MAC) is true?

options.label: A
options.text: MAC is the lowest for nitrous oxide

options.label: B
options.text: MAC is used to compare the potency of inhaled anesthetics

options.label: C
options.text: MAC is a measure of the blood concentration of anesthetic agents

options.label: D
options.text: MAC does not vary with age
